items.name: Evanston Summer Big Cubes 2023
items.information: For the first time, we are bringing a cubing competition to the campus of Northwestern University! This competition is in series with [Lisle Summer 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisleSummer2023) and [Evanston Summer Side Events 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerSideEvents2023). You will only be allowed to compete in one of these three competitions. Please read all tabs before registering. On the day of the competition, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1pHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0cce46ccb8ede2ca53e36e1dc73b399d2c9ffde0/image.png)
